title: WorkSession
description: A stretch of work somebody keeps coming back to, and the defaults everything made inside it starts from. Named work-session, not session, because it has nothing to do with being signed in: it outlives any login and carries no credential.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

person.description: The wallet, handle, or id under localIds of whoever is working. Absent while the work is anonymous — a session can exist before anybody has signed in for it.

workspace.description: The id of the workspace the session sits in, in the system that owns workspaces.

name.description: What the person called it. Absent until they bother to name it.

brandName.description: The brand the work is for, as typed. A name, not a reference: the session is written before anybody decides whether that brand is a record anywhere.

defaultChannel.description: Where work made here is headed unless told otherwise. Free text: the channels belong to the system that publishes.

defaultObjective.description: What work made here is for unless told otherwise. Free text, in the vocabulary of whoever set it.

lastSeen.description: When it was last touched. The reason the record is worth keeping: it says which sessions are still alive.
